example_en: It was a difficult period in my life.
example_uk: Це був складний період у моєму житті.
notes: Cambridge Dictionary confirms UK IPA /ˈpɪə.ri.əd/ and B1 noun sense meaning a length of time. The punctuation sense 'period' is mainly US; British English normally uses 'full stop', so the previous A1 example and translation were inappropriate for a British-English learner list. Replaced with a B1 time-period example and matching Ukrainian translation.
Cambridge Learner's Dictionary labels the adjective senses B1 and gives UK pronunciation /ˈpɜːs ə n ə l/. The example uses the private/personal-life sense; Ukrainian translation is accurate.
